text:
Sofia (CS): Heads-up — ZenFold needs a short APAC cutover window and an allowlist for their Singapore proxy. They asked for a 48h temporary QPS increase (2x) to handle blue-green traffic during rollout. Can we support?
Ravi (ZenFold Ops): Cutover Thursday 22:00-02:00 UTC. Sources: 35.200.0.0/16 and 34.82.128.0/18. HTTPS only. Renewal conversation in two weeks, so smooth cutover is high priority.
Liam (NetOps): I can add those CIDRs to apac-proxy. Recommend auto-revoke 72h. Confirm only port 443?
Ravi (ZenFold Ops): Yes, only 443. 72h revoke fine.
Priya (Platform): We'll create a tenant-scoped policy zenfold-migrate-283333 with rate_multiplier=2.0. Suggest canary 10% for 15m then full. Also enable prefix KV cache for /chat to reduce tail latency.
Diego (SE): Please enable tokenization logging and set per-request cap at 6k tokens — they had a few runaway jobs last week.
Sofia (CS): Plan summary: (1) Liam adds CIDRs + auto-revoke 72h, (2) Priya schedules rate boost with canary, (3) Diego flips prefix cache and token diag, (4) Ravi runs two synthetics and uploads results to the onboarding drive.
Liam (NetOps): egress-rule created id=egress-zf-283333, cidrs=[35.200.0.0/16,34.82.128.0/18], ports=[443], region=ap-southeast-1, auto_revoke=259200s.
Priya (Platform): rollout zenfold-migrate-283333 scheduled: canary 10% 15m -> full, expires=2025-10-10T02:00:00Z. Applying tenant flags now.
Diego (SE): config snippet:
````
route: /chat
features:
  prefix_kv_cache: true
  kv_ttl: 3600
  max_cached_prefix_tokens: 2048
  tokenization_logging: info
  per_request_token_cap: 6000
````
Priya (Platform): flags pushed for tenant. Deploying canary at start time.
ops-bot: rollout zenfold-migrate-283333 started (canary 10%).
Sofia (CS): Ravi please run: (A) 200x 256-token gen (B) 5k-token summarize x5 during the window and upload latency + error logs.
Ravi (ZenFold Ops): Will run tests and upload to https://redwooddrive.company/onboarding/zenfold/cutover. On call at 21:30 UTC.
priya (Platform): canary healthy. p95 ~130ms. promoting to full.
ops-bot: rollout zenfold-migrate-283333 promoted to full; auto-revoke scheduled.
Ravi (ZenFold Ops): Tests uploaded. 256-token p95 135ms, 5k-token p95 380ms, no 5xxs.
Sofia (CS): Great — capture exec summary for renewal pack. Priya/Liam please confirm cleanup once auto-revoke runs.
ops-bot: egress rule egress-zf-283333 revoked after 72h.
Liam (NetOps): cleanup verified.
Sofia (CS): Closing loop — customer satisfied, marking positive for renewal. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
